extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance data appear in Figure 1 only. Figures 2–8 are characterization/TPR/TPD plots and Figure 9 is in situ infrared mechanistic spectroscopy; these were skipped because they do not report measured catalytic conversion, product selectivity, or methanol formation rate/STY. No CO, CH4 selectivity, or methanol STY/formation-rate values are plotted in the main text.
